facts.fact: ACP reports SCPT has worked on an online postcode directory, aimed at giving the DRC a national addressing infrastructure, covering quarters, communes, sectors and post offices of the provinces and towns chosen for a pilot phase.

systems.system: SCPT online postcode directory (portail de codes postaux)
systems.owner: Societe congolaise des postes et telecommunications (SCPT)

COD.note: The document is about postal codes and says nothing on local government office connection.
